title: Adam-ondi-Ahman
notes: ~280 individual articles A-Z; very high KG value (each = concept node)

footnotes.text: Several early revelations contained information about Adam-ondi-Ahman. For example, a March 1832 revelation explained that in “pure language,”Ahmanis the name of God. See “Sample of Pure Language, between circa 4 and circa 20 March 1832,” in Revelation Book 1, 144,josephsmithpapers.org. See also Robin Scott Jensen, Robert J. Woodford, and Steven C. Harper, eds.,Revelations and Translations, Volume 1: Manuscript Revelation Books.Vol. 1 of the Revelations and Translations series ofThe Joseph Smith Papers,edited by Dean C. Jessee, Ronald K. Esplin, and Richard Lyman Bushman (Salt Lake City: Church Historian’s Press, 2011), 204–6. An 1835 revelation now known asDoctrine and Covenants 107explains that it was in the valley of Adam-ondi-Ahman that Adam bestowed upon his posterity his last blessing (D&C 107:53; see also “Instruction on Priesthood, between circa 1 March and circa 4 May 1835 [D&C 107],” in Doctrine and Covenants, 1835 ed., 86,josephsmithpapers.org).

Doctrine and Covenants 116; see also Joseph Smith, “Journal, March–September 1838,” 43–44,josephsmithpapers.org. Joseph Smith later described a future meeting in which Adam, who “presides over the spirits of all men” as the “father of the human family” would “call his children, together” to “prepare them for the coming of the son of man” and “[deliver] up his stewardship to Christ” (“Discourse, between circa 26 June and circa 4 August 1839–A, as Reported by Unknown Scribe,” 2, 3,josephsmithpapers.org).
